records.statement: Everything is by reference.
records.interpretation: Connections must not be represented by silently copying complete target objects into every assembly.
records.limits: The exact direct-reference, occurrence-reference, relationship, metadata, cycle and storage forms are not yet decided.

records.statement: Reference is the connection mechanism; relationship is the meaning assigned to a connection.
records.interpretation: A reference alone must not silently imply ownership, membership, composition, order, depth, derivation or authority.
records.limits: A final relationship vocabulary and representation have not been accepted.

records.statement: Possessing an artifact reference does not grant permission to open, copy, execute or trust the target.
records.interpretation: Resolution policy and authority are separate from reference identity.
records.limits: The general Holon resolver and permission model are not designed.

records.statement: Holon is the general semantic unit.
records.interpretation: Independently represented semantic units may use the common Holon model.
records.limits: What makes a unit atomic and which scalars become independent holons remain unresolved.

records.statement: A holoquary is still a holon, described through composition rather than as a separate object species.
records.interpretation: One recursive unit form can participate both as an independently identified whole and as an aggregate.
records.limits: The final composition/reference representation is not settled.

records.statement: Reuse holons recursively while keeping application material modular.
records.interpretation: Common structure does not require common application semantics or behavior.
records.limits: Recursion was deliberately deferred in the separate UPST v0.1 application contract.

records.statement: Identity describes the whole and defines its roles and how things can be done.
records.interpretation: Identity is broader than a UUID, message ID, readable name or provenance claim.
records.limits: Identity persistence, revision and variant rules remain open.

records.statement: Identifiers are constituent descriptions, initially including Name, IDs, Aliases, Derivation or Lineage, and Variations.
records.interpretation: An identifier is part of identity description, not proof of authenticity or the whole identity.
records.limits: Generation, namespace, uniqueness, edit stability and variant linkage are unresolved.

records.statement: Holon Wrapper contains Holon Compartment; a compartment may expose Holoquary Self with Identifiers and ID, or Holoquary Composition with Holoquary/Holon and Data.
records.interpretation: This later absolute structure replaces the earlier four mandatory root fields as the general foundation.
records.limits: Whether Self and Composition coexist in one compartment remains open.

records.statement: Self-only, composition-only, empty wrapper, no-compartment wrapper and one-or-more-empty-compartment states must remain distinguishable.
records.interpretation: Serialization must not silently collapse semantically distinct empty states.
records.limits: Exact encoding, sentinel occurrences and internal-catalog placement are open.

records.statement: The complete structure catalog is to exist externally and internally as a holon.
records.interpretation: The catalog is part of the model and also has an external counterpart.
records.limits: Finite self-description, correspondence, versioning and placement in minimal forms are unresolved.

records.statement: Cataloged sentinel holons replace native null in the new general representation while preserving originating native states.
sources: HDH-0930/RESEARCH_NOTES.md Subsequent Programmatic-State and Transfer Research
records.interpretation: Absence, null-like values, empty values, optional absence and special signals must not be flattened.
records.limits: Sentinel IDs, occurrence form, supported profiles and reconstruction mappings are unresolved.

records.statement: Relationships and coordination are broader than a depth hierarchy; membership and composition are relationship concepts.
records.interpretation: Depth can describe a view without becoming the universal relationship semantics.
records.limits: Final placement, edge form, coordination form and validators are open.

records.statement: The earlier wrapper used Identifier, Name, Role, Data and ordered identifier references carrying relative Holon Depth.
records.interpretation: Useful as a historical hierarchical ordering view, but not the current general foundation.
records.limits: Must not be promoted back into universal relationship semantics.

records.statement: Story blocks, block cyphers, source payloads and read-aloud records are application forms, not proven universal primitives.
records.interpretation: Strmdocx may choose blocks as a storage or stream form without asserting block equals holon in every context.
records.limits: The block/holon equivalence and granularity policy are open.

records.statement: Direct target references, occurrence-reference holons, relationship holons, metadata references and ordinal coordination have not been selected.
records.interpretation: The current reference requirement constrains copying but does not complete the wire/storage schema.
records.limits: Requires a separate design decision before implementation.

records.statement: Identifier generation, scope, revisions, edits, lineage and variants are unresolved.
records.interpretation: Hashes, message IDs and illustrative UUID strings cannot substitute for the missing policy.
records.limits: No generator or uniqueness claim is authorized.

records.statement: What makes a holon atomic and how blocks map to holons are unresolved.
records.interpretation: Do not force every scalar, glyph, block or storage allocation into one unreviewed unit policy.
records.limits: Depends on the future encoding and storage model.

records.statement: The three empty states, coexistence of Self and Composition, and catalog placement in minimum forms remain unresolved.
records.interpretation: An empty object or array must not be chosen as a universal collapse without a semantic decision.
records.limits: No basic wrapper serialization is produced in this mining scope.

records.statement: Internal/external catalog correspondence and the two separately located encoding codices lack final version and procedure rules.
records.interpretation: Location requirements do not imply identical bytes, processing order or accepted codec algorithms.
records.limits: No codex or codec implementation is authorized.

records.statement: Originator leads to Emitter, then Source, whose listed components are Encoder, Database, Data and Metadata, Holon Atomics, Encoded Holon Wrapper, Recovery Information, Regeneration Information, and Protocol Wrapper and Attestation.
records.interpretation: The displayed edges are not automatically ownership or composed-holon edges.
records.limits: Emitter/Source meaning, emissions representation and component internals remain open.

records.statement: Attestation contents, issuers and verification, and the exact recovery/regeneration distinction are unresolved.
records.interpretation: Hashes, local validation and receipts cannot be promoted into the proposed protocol attestations.
records.limits: No signing, codec, verifier or executed attestation protocol exists in the sources.

records.statement: UPST v0.1 defines a strict nonrecursive JSON application packet, not a transport or universal Holon schema.
records.interpretation: It can inform boundary design without becoming native reference storage.
records.limits: No accepted UPTI API, delivery mechanism or generic recursion.

records.statement: The packet requires nine named top-level keys, rejects unknown top-level keys and accepts three body kinds.
records.interpretation: A closed transfer profile can coexist with an extensible referenced model only if the boundary is explicit.
records.limits: The closed envelope is not evidence that the general Holon model is closed.

records.statement: DECISION, producer_hint, consumer_hint, message_id and provenance are untrusted application data and do not authorize action.
records.interpretation: Epistemic classification and authorization must remain separate.
records.limits: A trusted external identity/authority channel is not supplied.

records.statement: An artifact reference contains basename, hash and byte count but does not automatically materialize or open a file.
records.interpretation: Reference resolution and effect require a separately authorized mechanism.
records.limits: Artifact existence and sender authority are not proven.

records.authority_class: candidate contract versus later general requirement
records.statement: UPST v0.1 requires native JSON null in declared ABSENT record fields, while the general Holon direction replaces native null with sentinel holons.
records.interpretation: The application boundary may be historical, external or adapter-mediated; no reconciliation is adopted.
records.limits: Do not rewrite either source into false agreement.

records.statement: Numerical data, knowledge possibilities, execution state and provenance are kept distinct.
records.interpretation: Avoid consuming uncertainty grades, errors, provenance or claim labels as numerical operands.
records.limits: The unbundled Holoquary v1.2 source prevents independent baseline comparison.

records.statement: The v0.1 payload intentionally defers generic recursion.
records.interpretation: It is a boundary packet, not the recursive Holon composition model.
records.limits: Do not infer that the general Holon model is nonrecursive.

records.statement: READY_FOR_UPTI_HANDOFF is a local prepared state, not transfer, delivery, authentication or receiver acknowledgment.
records.interpretation: Lifecycle names must not launder preparation into external success.
records.limits: No receiver or network call exists.

records.statement: The v0.2 local staging path returns the same validated input bytes and records no local transformation.
records.interpretation: Byte preservation is separable from semantic equivalence and downstream fidelity.
records.limits: Only the tested local path is covered.

records.statement: Duplicate IDs and receiver capabilities are process-local reservations and caller-supplied assumptions, not durable replay protection or authenticated negotiation.
records.interpretation: Restart loses replay memory; ReceiverProfile proves no peer identity.
records.limits: Durable freshness, trusted identity and remote negotiation are absent.

records.statement: UPTI-SF is retained as NOT_USED, INACTIVE and EXCLUDED_FROM_CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE.
records.interpretation: Mining its invariants does not activate or adopt it.
records.limits: Reactivation would require an explicit future architectural decision and new status record.

records.statement: Preserve source, stage provisionally, verify before commit, declare loss, retain recovery evidence and release source only with explicit authority.
records.interpretation: Useful safety discipline for future transformation services without adopting UPTI-SF as a runtime.
records.limits: The historical implementation is absent and the component is inactive.

records.statement: UPST v0.1 passed 10 of 10 supplied tests and UPTI v0.2 passed 34 of 34 supplied tests under local Python standard-library execution.
records.interpretation: The tested payload and local staging behaviors passed in the current environment.
records.limits: No network, transport, authentication, cryptography, receiver or external attestation was tested.

records.statement: The nested UPTI-SF export reports earlier integration, fuzzy, torture and crash-oriented success, but those results could not be rerun from the supplied specification-only package.
records.interpretation: Retain as project-history evidence, not current observed validation.
records.limits: Historical executable implementation and complete test corpus are absent.

records.authority_class: source error log plus current passing rerun
records.statement: Two assistant-originated defects were preserved: unbounded extension nesting and an invalid Unicode fixture that initially tested ordinary text.
records.interpretation: A failing negative test can reveal a product defect or a defective fixture; preserve and distinguish both before correction.
records.limits: Passing corrected cases do not prove general memory safety or secure deserialization.

records.statement: Do not rename preparation, fallback, recovery, syntax validity, hashing or local receipt as primary external success.
records.interpretation: Each evidence class must retain its own proof boundary.
records.limits: This is a mined design rule, not an implemented technical interlock.

records.statement: The application contract's declared native-null fields and the later general sentinel-holon requirement coexist without an accepted adapter rule.
records.interpretation: Preserve the difference; do not normalize one into the other during mining.
records.limits: Requires a versioned boundary decision.

records.statement: The candidate packet nests body structures and forbids unknown top-level keys, while the current general direction is recursive, extensible and reference-addressed.
records.interpretation: The packet may be a resolved boundary view, not native storage; no mapping is adopted.
records.limits: Requires an explicit serialization/profile design.

records.statement: All thirteen nonmanifest v0.1 files match the embedded legacy copy; the v0.2 root reuses ten of them unchanged and supersedes the spelling/status documents only for the new candidate boundary.
records.interpretation: Duplicate copies establish lineage and preservation, not independent corroboration.
records.limits: The separate manifests and archive containers remain distinct artifacts.

records.statement: UPTI is the current term in the candidate; UPST remains in byte-preserved historical sources and is not a second protocol.
records.interpretation: Preserve the old spelling in source locators while using UPTI for the later candidate.
records.limits: This terminology correction does not activate or canonize the candidate API.

records.statement: The normalized Holoquary v1.2 source named as the computational substrate was not bundled or inspected.
records.interpretation: The v0.1/v0.2 claims of inherited invariants can be inspected in their own code but not compared against the named baseline source.
records.limits: The recorded digest was not independently verified.

records.statement: A nested strict JSON application packet may be treated as a resolved transport view over a reference-native model, provided the mapping is explicit and loss is recorded.
records.interpretation: This reconciles interface convenience with native references without claiming the mapping already exists.
records.limits: Not a user-adopted architecture or implemented adapter.
